request:
镜头 s15：纪录片现场纪实镜头，时长 10 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：observational documentary footage from a research institute's own 2050s film archive, shot on Super 16 colour negative: lively visible grain, slightly soft resolution, cold fluorescent light mixed with one warm desk lamp, muted desaturated palette, deep shadows, imperfect handheld framing
该类型的纪录片默认机位：fly-on-the-wall documentary camera, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings, operator reacting late
导演意图（自然语言）：手持中景，轻微晃动。工作台上，一堆不一样的旧机器用线连成一团，旁边是一台崭新的黑色服务器。宋工指着屏幕上两条交叉的曲线对波爷说；波爷盯着屏幕，慢慢推了推眼镜。环境声：风扇声、机器的嗡鸣。
情绪：triumphant, quiet, revelatory
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium shot, handheld with a gentle sway
景深与虚实：Natural depth of field, the monitor glow slightly blooming.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Night in the lab, handheld documentary medium shot: on the workbench a scrappy tangle of mismatched cheap machines (an old radio, a robot-arm controller board, a cash-register board, two dented tin boxes) wired together, next to one sleek black server unit; Song points at a monitor showing two abstract glowing curves that cross each other; Boye stares at the screen. Blocking lock: the tangle of cheap machines sits at frame left on the bench, the sleek black server at frame right; the monitor with the two curves at the back centre; Song stands centre-left pointing at it, Boye at frame right facing the screen.
Picture 2: Boye at 44 (Song's colleague, network protocol engineer, in the 2050s) (character reference; role: Song's colleague). A 44-year-old Chinese man, network protocol engineer: short black hair with the first grey streaks, dark stubble, intact black-framed glasses, a broad nose and a stubborn mouth. Dark navy quilted work jacket over a brown knitted vest.
Picture 3: the 550 project laboratory at night (2050s) (location reference; role: location reference). Interior of the quantum-computer laboratory of a national research institute at night in the 2050s: a long cluttered engineer's workbench with a soldering station, oscilloscopes, coils of wire, circuit boards and notebooks under a desk lamp; behind a large glass wall, a cold clean server hall with rows of tall black cabinets and, on the central black cabinet, a single round red-glowing camera lens exactly like the terminal in the reference image. Fluorescent tubes. Empty of people.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Song (a man in his early thirties, warm and gentle voice with a smile in it) — 宋工（三十出头男性的声音，温和、带笑意）: 两三台不一样的破机器连起来，就能赢过一台最强的。
现场环境声：cooling fans whirring, electrical hum, a faint relay click
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 10.0s, 24fps, observational documentary footage from a research institute's own 2050s film archive, shot on Super 16 colour negative: lively visible grain, slightly soft resolution, cold fluorescent light mixed with one warm desk lamp, muted desaturated palette, deep shadows, imperfect handheld framing; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, medium shot, shoulder-mounted handheld camera with a gentle sway and one small late reframing that drifts a little to the right and settles; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. The tangle of mismatched cheap machines sits at frame left on the workbench, the sleek black server at frame right, the glowing monitor at the back centre; Song stands centre-left, Boye frame right with his shoulder in the near foreground; the bench edge and a coil of wire are in the soft foreground. Start: Song's arm comes up from his side and his fingertip settles on the glass of the monitor, right where the two curves cross; beside him the old radio's dial lamp flickers faintly, the cables trembling with the hum of the machines. Middle: he turns his head from the screen toward Boye and back again, tapping the crossing point twice, and the monitor glow pulses gently across his cheekbone and the lenses of Boye's glasses; Boye leans in an inch, hands loose at his sides, then lifts his right hand and slowly pushes his black-framed glasses up the bridge of his nose with one knuckle, the frames catching a thin white reflection of the screen. End: Song's hand stays raised against the monitor, the two curves still crossing behind his fingertip, and Boye holds still, mouth slightly open, eyes fixed on the glow; the handheld frame settles and holds on the two of them and the screen. Mood: triumphant, quiet, revelatory. Blur: the crossing curves and the two men's faces stay sharp; the far server hall behind the glass wall and the clutter at the frame edges fall into soft grain-blurred grey, the monitor glow blooming slightly at its edges. Song (a man in his early thirties, warm and gentle voice with a smile in it) says, <d>[Chinese] 两三台不一样的破机器连起来，就能赢过一台最强的。</d>; Final line of this shot: end on "就能赢过一台最强的", complete the whole sentence, no cut-off; after the last line nobody speaks. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Cooling fans whirring from the server hall behind the glass, steady electrical hum of the bench machines, a faint relay click from the tangle of cheap machines, the thin buzz of fluorescent tubes, the creak of a stool leg, fabric rustle as Boye leans in, the small dry tap of a fingertip on monitor glass, quiet male breathing; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
